concepts.gloss_en: light (or) — the primordial/created light, contrasted with darkness; symbol of the tzaddik's deeds, day, and peace
ur — flame/fire read as 'light,' used in the wordplay on Aramaic 'urzila' (ur zila) to denote glory (kavod)

reason_for_human: Three occurrences are vocalized אוֹר (or, 'light') — the standard light/darkness motif — and are clearly one word. The fourth is vocalized אוּר (ur, shuruk), a distinct lexeme (flame/fire) invoked purely for the Aramaic wordplay 'urzila → ur zila'; the differing vocalization is authoritative homograph evidence, so I split it out rather than merge on the shared consonants.
